name: @equin/plugin-framework-cli-test-main-standing
description: Where a failing test file stands on main — the one notion of "already failing on main" (judgeFailure over the harvested verdicts: at the merge base's digest by majority, else main's own newest), with main's test-failing report and owner task about it. Printed by `./equin test` under a failing run and used by the push test gate.
